news.summary: A law firm probe into Jensen Huang's ties to Alice Huang could end his run at Nvidia, and the company has no obvious heir. Who could Wall Street, governments, and customers all accept in his place?
news.title: Eric Schmidt, Former Google CEO, Should Run Nvidia
news.title_zh: 前 Google 執行長 Eric Schmidt 應該經營 Nvidia
news.summary_zh: 律師事務所對 Jensen Huang 與 Alice Huang 關係的調查可能結束他在 Nvidia 的任期，而該公司沒有明顯繼承人。誰能讓華爾街、政府和客戶都接受接替他的位置？

news.summary: Key TakeawaysMicrosoft shares fell 2% after Anthropic added Claude Sheets, Claude Whiteboards and Claude Data to its paid Claude plans at no extra charge. The threat to Office looks smaller than the selloff suggests, since Alphabet has offered free Office rivals for years and Microsoft 365 commercial cloud revenue grew 17% last quarter.
news.title: Microsoft Is “No Longer the Bundler” as Anthropic Gives Away Office Rivals, Says Jason Calacanis
news.title_zh: 微軟「不再是捆綁者」 隨著Anthropic免費提供Office競品，Jason Calacanis表示
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要微軟股價下跌 2%，因Anthropic在其付費Claude方案中免費新增Claude Sheets、Claude Whiteboards和Claude Data。由於Alphabet多年來一直提供免費Office競品，且微軟 365 商業雲端營收上季成長 17%，Office面臨的威脅比拋售潮暗示的要小。

news.summary: Alphabet Inc (NASDAQ:GOOG), the Google parent company, is exploring its first Hong Kong and Singapore dollar bond sales worth up to $3 billion combined. The technology group is targeting between $1 billion and $1.5 billion from Hong Kong dollar-denominated bonds and approximately $1.5 billion...
news.title: Alphabet explores first Hong Kong and Singapore dollar bond sales worth up to $3 billion

news.summary_zh: Alphabet Inc (NASDAQ:GOOG)，Google 母公司，正在探索其首次港幣和新加坡幣債券銷售，總價值高達 $3 billion。該科技集團目標是從港幣計價債券籌集 $1 billion 到 $1.5 billion 之間，以及約 $1.5 billion...

news.summary: Key TakeawaysGoogle unveiled the TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max on Monday, adding to the 8t and 8i it introduced in April. Google Cloud revenue climbed 103% to $30.
news.title: Alphabet Fell 10% on a $9.1 Billion Cash Burn. Do Two New TPUs Make It a Buy?
news.title_zh: Alphabet因 $9.1 Billion 現金燃燒率下跌 10%。兩款新TPU讓它成為買進對象？
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要：Google 於週一發布 TPU 8tx 和 TPU 8i Max，新增了 8t 和 8i（於四月推出）。Google Cloud 營收攀升 103% 至 $30。

news.summary: Alphabet and CoreWeave are both positioned to benefit from AI, but one has a much stronger financial foundation.
news.title: Alphabet or CoreWeave: Which AI Stock Is Better to Buy in a Market Crash?
news.title_zh: Alphabet 或 CoreWeave：市場崩盤時哪檔 AI 股票較適合買進？
news.summary_zh: Alphabet 和 CoreWeave 都有望從 AI 獲益，但其中一家擁有強得多的財務基礎。

news.summary: Google sells its own TPUs and Amazon pushes Trainium, yet both keep writing NVIDIA enormous checks. One supply bottleneck and one software moat explain why the custom-chip threat may be harder to execute than it looks.
news.title: Why Alphabet and Amazon Will Always Need Nvidia
news.title_zh: 為何 Alphabet 和 Amazon 永遠都需要 Nvidia
news.summary_zh: Google 銷售自家 TPU，Amazon 推動 Trainium，但兩者持續開出龐大支票給 NVIDIA。一個供應瓶頸和一個軟體護城河，解釋了為何自研晶片威脅執行起來可能比看起來更難。

news.summary: Key TakeawaysInvestor Patrick O’Shaughnessy said he heard secondhand that Larry Page, co-founder of Google and its parent Alphabet, expects 99. 999% of compute to end up in orbit, and Elon Musk called it one of Page’s many accurate predictions.
news.title: “Five-Nines”: Larry Page Reportedly Sees 99.999% of Compute in Orbit, and Musk Agrees
news.title_zh: 「五個九」：據報 Larry Page 看好 99.999% 算力進入軌道，Musk 表示贊同
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要投資人 Patrick O’Shaughnessy 表示他間接聽聞，Google 聯合創始人暨其母公司 Alphabet 創始人 Larry Page 預期 99。 999% 算力最終將進入軌道，Elon Musk 稱這是 Page 眾多準確預測之一。

news.summary: Does Google's bigger Anthropic stake move the needle for Alphabet? Anthropic's amended S-1 filing shows the size, the price, and the risks.
news.title: Alphabet Is Set to Become an Even Bigger Anthropic Shareholder After the IPO
news.title_zh: Alphabet 有望在 IPO 後成為 Anthropic 更大股東
news.summary_zh: Google 更大的 Anthropic 持股能否為 Alphabet 帶來實質影響？Anthropic 修訂後的 S-1 申報文件揭露了規模、價格與風險。

news.summary: Key TakeawaysNvidia fell 4% on Monday after its board opened an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang. Nvidia’s 71% gross margin gives its biggest buyers every reason to back cheaper chips, and Anthropic training its AI almost entirely on chips Google designs shows how that can work.
news.title: Nvidia’s 70% to 80% Margins Are “Like Throwing Chum in the Water,” Says Its Biographer
news.title_zh: Nvidia 的 70% to 80% 利潤率「像在水裡撒魚餌」，其傳記作者表示
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Nvidia 在週一下跌 4%，因董事會展開對 CEO 黃仁勳的調查。Nvidia 的 71% 毛利率讓其最大買家有充分理由支持更便宜的晶片，而 Anthropic 幾乎完全使用 Google 設計的晶片訓練 AI，展示了這如何運作。

news.summary: Key TakeawaysAlphabet’s Google, Nvidia, Microsoft, Broadcom, AMD, Micron and TSMC will buy $26 billion of Anthropic’s shares at its IPO price, on top of an offering of up to $64. 4 billion.
news.title: Google, Nvidia and Microsoft “Literally Feeding Themselves Money” with $26 Billion Anthropic IPO Buy
news.title_zh: Google、Nvidia 和 Microsoft 透過 $26 Billion Anthropic IPO 認購「簡直在餵自己錢」
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Alphabet 旗下 Google、Nvidia、Microsoft、Broadcom、AMD、Micron 和 TSMC 將以 IPO 價格購買 $26 billion Anthropic 股份，此外還有高達 $64 的發售。 4 billion.

news.summary: Key TakeawaysJason Calacanis, a Tesla shareholder, said on This Week in Startups that after the midterms Democrats will “block autonomy,” a bigger risk for tech than data centers. The risk is bigger for Tesla than for Alphabet’s Waymo, since Elon Musk says Cybercab will dominate only where the law allows it, and Tesla is moving Cybertruck out of Giga Texas to build more of them.
news.title: Tesla Bull Predicts Democrats Will “Block Autonomy,” a Bigger Risk Than Data Centers
news.title_zh: 特斯拉多頭預測民主黨將「封鎖自動駕駛」，風險大於數據中心
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要：特斯拉股東傑森·卡拉卡尼斯在《This Week in Startups》節目中表示，中期選舉後民主黨將「封鎖自動駕駛」，這對科技業的風險大於數據中心。由於埃隆·馬斯克表示 Cybercab 只會在法律允許的地方佔據主導地位，因此這項風險對特斯拉的影響大於 Alphabet 旗下的 Waymo，且特斯拉正將 Cybertruck 從 Giga Texas 遷出以增加產量。

news.summary: Key TakeawaysOn Friday, Bloomberg reported that buyers in Anthropic’s IPO see a valuation as low as $1. 1 trillion.
news.title: Andrew Ross Sorkin: Anthropic’s IPO Is “the Linchpin” for Amazon, Google and Microsoft
news.title_zh: 安德魯·羅斯·索金：Anthropic 的 IPO 是亞馬遜、Google 和微軟的「關鍵」
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要：週五，彭博社報導稱，Anthropic IPO 的買方認為估值低至 $1。 1 trillion.

news.title: Trump’s Commerce Dept. Halted a Chip Probe “After Nvidia Intervention.” That’s Nvidia’s Bigger Problem

news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點《紐約時報》報導，商務部對Megaspeed的調查在輝達首席律師點名一位川普提名官員後被叫停。Megaspeed進口數十億美元的輝達設備到馬來西亞，為服務中國客戶（包括阿里巴巴）的資料中心提供服務。

news.summary: Key TakeawaysAlibaba stock rose 12% in the past week after Apple picked Qwen for its China AI launch. Money also rotated out of US AI hardware into cheap Chinese internet stocks like Alibaba and Tencent.
news.title: Alibaba Just Gained 12% in a Week as the Nasdaq Fell: Take Profits, or Buy More?
news.title_zh: 阿里巴巴在一週內上漲 12%，而納斯達克下跌：獲利了結，還是加碼買入？
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要阿里巴巴股價在過去一週上漲 12%，因蘋果選擇 Qwen 為其中國 AI 發布。資金也從美國 AI 硬體輪動撤出，流入阿里巴巴和騰訊等便宜的中國網路股。

news.summary: Alibaba is evolving from a China consumption proxy to a full-stack AI infrastructure leader with a proven AI monetization model. Read why BABA stock is a buy.
news.title: Alibaba FY Q2 2027 Preview: Quietly Winning The AI War
news.title_zh: 阿里巴巴 FY Q2 2027 前瞻：悄然贏得AI戰爭

news.summary: Key TakeawaysChinese AI and cloud firms, Alibaba among them, have ordered about 6 million NVIDIA RTX Pro 5500 chips worth about $70 billion, but expect to get only about 1% of them over the next four months. With too little capacity to go around, NVIDIA is building its most advanced, higher-margin chips first, so China’s orders are left waiting.
news.title: Nvidia’s Chinese Clients Will Get Just 1% of $70 Billion in RTX Chip Orders
news.title_zh: Nvidia 的中國客戶在 RTX 晶片訂單中將僅獲得 1% 之 $70 Billion
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要中國 AI 與雲端企業（包括阿里巴巴）已訂購約 6 million 顆 NVIDIA RTX Pro 5500 晶片，價值約 $70 billion，但預期未來四個月僅能獲得其中約 1%。因產能不足，NVIDIA 優先生產最先進、利潤較高的晶片，導致中國訂單被迫等待。

news.summary: Amazon and Alibaba are investing heavily in the future of e-commerce and artificial intelligence, but a substantial valuation gap could make one the more attractive opportunity heading into 2027.
news.title: Amazon vs. Alibaba: Two E-Commerce Giants, a Big Valuation Gap, but Which Offers More Upside in 2027?
news.title_zh: Amazon vs. Alibaba：兩大電商巨頭，估值差距巨大，但哪一檔在 2027 更具上漲潛力？

news.summary: Alibaba consistently outpaces Target by billions each quarter, but both reveal identical seasonal patterns that could reshape how investors value growth.
news.title: Alibaba vs. Target: Comparing Revenue Trends Between Two Retail Titans
news.title_zh: Alibaba vs. Target：比較兩大零售巨頭的營收趨勢
news.summary_zh: Alibaba 每季持續以數十億美元超越 Target，但兩者呈現相同的季節性模式，可能重塑投資人對成長的估值方式。

news.summary: Key TakeawaysAlibaba shares jumped 6% after Apple picked Qwen for its December AI launch in China, while JD. com and PDD Holdings rose on Chinese market support.
news.title: Alibaba Soars 6% as Apple Sets December Launch for Qwen-Powered iPhone AI in China
news.title_zh: 阿里巴巴飆升 6%，蘋果訂於十二月在中國推出搭載 Qwen 的 iPhone AI
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要阿里巴巴股價跳升 6%，因蘋果選擇 Qwen 作為其十二月在中國的 AI 推出，而京東和拼多多控股因中國市場支持而上漲。

news.summary: Key TakeawaysApple will launch its first Apple Intelligence features in mainland China with iOS 27. 3 in December, with Alibaba’s Qwen inside Siri, Writing Tools and Visual Intelligence and Baidu also building features for Chinese users.
news.title: Apple Made $64.85 Billion in China in 9 Months Without AI. Now Alibaba’s Qwen Is Coming to Siri
news.title_zh: 蘋果在中國 $64.85 Billion，在 9 個月內未使用 AI。現在阿里巴巴的 Qwen 即將進駐 Siri
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Apple 將在中國大陸推出其首個 Apple Intelligence 功能，搭配 iOS 27。3 在十二月，阿里巴巴的 Qwen 將內建於 Siri、寫作工具和視覺智能中，百度也在為中國用戶建構功能。

news.summary: Evercore said that while investors’ initial concerns about competition were understandable, disrupting individual workplace tasks is different from the risk of displacing Microsoft 365.
news.title: Evercore Plays Down Microsoft 365 Disruption Fears After Anthropic’s Claude Sheets Launch – ‘Not Yet A Substitute For Excel’
news.title_zh: Evercore 淡化微軟 365 顛覆擔憂，因 Anthropic 推出 Claude Sheets ——「尚未能取代 Excel」
news.summary_zh: Evercore 指出，雖然投資者對競爭的初步擔憂可以理解，但顛覆個別工作任務與取代微軟 365 的風險截然不同。

news.title: AI Inference Startups Are Quietly Buying Their Own Chips
news.summary: The fast-growing crop of startups that lease computing capacity from cloud firms and then resell it, without spending a nickel on their own AI chips, are at a crossroads. Finding it harder to line up enough computing capacity to serve their customers, some are starting to buy their own chips, which is likely to drastically change the economics of their business. The difficulty in getting enough compute also has pushed some of these startups to look for computational resources from dozens of smaller neoclouds, which tend to have more available capacity than larger hyperscalers such as Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services and Google Cloud Platform. News this week of a hack of Fireworks, one of the best known of these startups, highlights the risk of that approach.
news.title_zh: AI 推理新創公司悄悄購買自家晶片
news.summary_zh: 這批快速成長的新創公司從雲端廠商租用運算容量再轉售，自己在 AI 晶片上一毛錢都不花，如今正處於十字路口。因更難湊齊足夠運算容量服務客戶，部分公司開始購買自家晶片，這極可能大幅改變其商業模式經濟性。取得足夠運算資源的困難，也推使部分新創公司尋找數十家較小型新雲端的運算資源，這些新雲端往往比微軟 Azure、亞馬遜網路服務和 Google Cloud Platform 等大型超大規模雲端有更多可用容量。本週 Fireworks 遭駭客攻擊的消息，凸顯該策略的風險。Fireworks 是這類新創公司中最知名者之一。

news.summary: Key TakeawaysMicrosoft shares fell 2% after Anthropic added Claude Sheets, Claude Whiteboards and Claude Data to its paid Claude plans at no extra charge. The threat to Office looks smaller than the selloff suggests, since Alphabet has offered free Office rivals for years and Microsoft 365 commercial cloud revenue grew 17% last quarter.
news.title: Microsoft Is “No Longer the Bundler” as Anthropic Gives Away Office Rivals, Says Jason Calacanis
news.title_zh: 微軟「不再是捆綁者」 隨著Anthropic免費提供Office競品，Jason Calacanis表示
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要微軟股價下跌 2%，因Anthropic在其付費Claude方案中免費新增Claude Sheets、Claude Whiteboards和Claude Data。由於Alphabet多年來一直提供免費Office競品，且微軟 365 商業雲端營收上季成長 17%，Office面臨的威脅比拋售潮暗示的要小。

news.summary: Key TakeawaysNebius stock fell 12% in a week as the midterms and a Microsoft report hit the neoclouds, IREN and CoreWeave included. Microsoft’s tighter oversight of Nebius’s projects is a bigger risk than the election, though Nebius carried a sliver of CoreWeave’s debt at midyear.
news.title: Nebius Sinks 12% in a Week: “Not All of These Companies Are Going to Make It”
news.title_zh: Nebius一週內暴跌 12%：「並非所有這些公司都能生存下來」
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點：Nebius股價一週內下跌 12%，因中期選舉和微軟報告打擊新雲端股，包括IREN和CoreWeave。微軟對Nebius項目更嚴格的監督比大選風險更大，儘管Nebius在年中時持有CoreWeave一小部分債務。

news.title: Amazon and Google Win Big From Anthropic IPO
news.summary: If you’re looking for a cheaper way of getting exposure to Anthropic than buying the stock directly, consider Amazon or Google. Anthropic’s updated IPO filing on Tuesday shows just how many shares each of those two tech giants will own in Anthropic, along with how much money they’re making on their early investments in the AI firm. Neither tech giant will own voting shares in Anthropic, so antitrust cops won’t have to worry about their influence over its management. But their stakes are significant. In theory, Amazon could own around 20% of Anthropic’s outstanding shares. But because of a self-imposed ownership cap, Amazon won’t hold more than 12% of Anthropic. The rest of its holdings are convertible notes that can convert to equity over time. Regardless, Amazon’s economic return is pretty damn good. Forgetting about the ownership cap for a minute, Amazon’s entire 20%-or-so stake would be worth about $258 billion at the midpoint of Anthropic’s proposed IPO pricing range. That’s from an investment totaling around $18.6 billion. (Anthropic’s final IPO price may well end up higher than the preliminary range, a Financial Times report tonight suggests).
news.title_zh: 亞馬遜與谷歌從 Anthropic IPO 大賺特賺
news.summary_zh: 若您想以比直接買股票更便宜的方式接觸 Anthropic，不妨考慮亞馬遜或谷歌。Anthropic 週二更新的 IPO 申報文件顯示，這兩大科技巨頭各自將持有多少 Anthropic 股份，以及它們在這家 AI 公司的早期投資賺了多少錢。兩大科技巨頭都不會持有 Anthropic 的有表決權股份，因此反壟斷機構無需擔心它們對管理層的影響力。但它們的股份相當可觀。理論上，亞馬遜可能持有約 20% 的 Anthropic 流通股。但因自我設定的持股上限，亞馬遜持股不會超過 12% 的 Anthropic。其餘持股為可轉換票據，可隨時間轉換為股權。無論如何，亞馬遜的經濟回報相當不錯。暫且不論持股上限，亞馬遜整個約 20% 的股份，按 Anthropic 擬議 IPO 價格區間中點計算，價值約 $258 billion。這源自總計約 $18.6 billion 的投資。（據《金融時報》今晚報導，Anthropic 最終 IPO 價格很可能高於初步區間）。

items.title: AI Inference Startups Are Quietly Buying Their Own Chips
items.summary: The fast-growing crop of startups that lease computing capacity from cloud firms and then resell it, without spending a nickel on their own AI chips, are at a crossroads. Finding it harder to line up enough computing capacity to serve their customers, some are starting to buy their own chips, which is likely to drastically change the economics of their business. The difficulty in getting enough compute also has pushed some of these startups to look for computational resources from dozens of smaller neoclouds, which tend to have more available capacity than larger hyperscalers such as Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services and Google Cloud Platform. News this week of a hack of Fireworks, one of the best known of these startups, highlights the risk of that approach.

items.title: Mosaic Raises Funds for Robotic Surgery
items.summary: Anthropic said on Tuesday that it has launched its roadshow, a 7 to 10 day period ahead of an IPO in which a company pitches prospective institutional investors like mutual funds, pension funds and hedge funds. Interestingly, the tentative valuation the Claude-maker set, of between $1.26 trillion to $1.4 trillion, was slightly lower than what investors initially expected. (And, it’s also around the $1.25 trillion valuation that OpenAI recently raised $11 billion at, despite the fact that Anthropic generates more revenue. That’s likely for several reasons, including that Anthropic likely wants its stock to have some wiggle room to trade up after its IPO.) Meanwhile, the largest pure-play robotics company in the world by revenue and market cap is Intuitive Surgical , which makes the da Vinci Surgical System , a multi-armed contraption that human surgeons use on a remote-control basis to perform a variety of operations. But da Vinci was first unveiled over 25 years ago, and a new generation of robotics companies is aiming to further automate surgery by harnessing the latest advances in AI.
